Logan — thanks for flagging. Quick notes from accounting perspective: 

1) Preferred path: issue a credit memo (invoice offset) tied to the invoice line rather than a unilateral write-off. This keeps accounts receivable and revenue trails intact and is preferable for customer auditability.

2) If product/service was never actually billed (e.g., invoice was estimated/placeholder), a write-off can be acceptable, but we should avoid that when an invoiced amount exists.

3) GLA mapping (proposed):
- Debit: Sales Discounts & Allowances (Account 5400) $12,000
- Credit: Accounts Receivable (Account 1200) $12,000

4) JE to clear after credit memo posting: Reference: CM-9857-CP

5) Approval: finance manager (Neha) + Revenue Ops (Marcus) sign-off. Legal review only if terms are being amended.

Marcus — I’m happy to draft the JE and the credit memo note. Do you have a preferred contra-revenue versus discount account? Also note customer asked about audit footprint; we should attach the grant agreement in the memo.

Neha
Accounting Manager
Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: one-time stipend write-off / invoice offset for POC

Thanks — agree with Neha. Additional operational notes from Revenue Ops / audit: 

- Use Sales Discounts & Allowances (5400) rather than other contra accounts; keeps reporting consistent across promos.
- Credit memo number format: CM-9857-CP-20261008. Please include a link to the grant PDF and the HubSpot deal id in the memo.
- For the customer-facing credit memo: short description: "Promotional pilot stipend per grant dated 2026-09-24. Not subject to deferred revenue."
- For tax: confirm with Tax team if customer needs a separate tax adjustment. If invoice was taxed, we should issue a tax credit memo.

Sample JE (Marcus proposed):
Date: 2026-10-09
Debit: Sales Discounts & Allowances (5400) $12,000
Credit: Accounts Receivable (1200) $12,000
Memo: Credit memo CM-9857-CP-20261008 for ClearPort pilot stipend; attached grant.

Logan — if you get written authorization from the ClearPort finance lead (Haley) confirming they want a credit memo, I’ll draft the CM and the JE CSV for posting. Irenе — can you do a 1-click approval in the ledger once the JE is uploaded?

Marcus
Revenue Operations
